scope: Read-only current Encode/EncodePacked/actualRPC CPU and allocation profile plus same-binary/same-function A/A GC context diagnosis.No production candidate,no new PB/TS ranking,do not replace historical comparisons or retry controls.

context.AandB: exact same function pointer;not two implementations
context.metrics: outside timed loop:heap objects/goal/scan,alloc bytes,GC cycles,GC/assist/user CPU estimates
context.full: KeepAlive all70 operations including their fixtures until end
context.isolated: construct same70,retain only selected operation,drop rest before explicit GC

assessment: One fixed profile per entry and one A/A run per context/case. No causal proof from correlation,GC CPU counters update coarsely. Instrumented A/A is a diagnostic,not old sampler timing or speedup/control replacement.Heap contexts/profiling are different workloads;preserve all raw counters,flags,outliers and setup overhead. No GOGC off,alloc reuse or production modifications.
